Pull request #3392 in re-cinq/lore: Spec tickets joins the Loops tab: a switch, and its runs on the board

Author: gedaiu

Closed: 2026-10-24T00:30:30Z

Link: https://github.com/re-cinq/lore/pull/3392

## Why

The `spec-tickets` line files story and task issues for every spec that merges, on every onboarded repository, with no way to turn it off and nothing on the Loops tab to show a run that failed. Every other loop that writes to GitHub on its own has a switch and board rows there; this one, which feeds the implementation loop its tickets, did not.

## Requirements

### The loop

- **FR14**: _(Added 2026-10-24.)_ Spec tickets is the **Spec tickets** loop of the repository's Loops tab, one entry of the loop registry (`LOOP_KINDS`, specs/implementation-loop). Its switch is `lore.repos.settings.spec_tickets.enabled`, on unless the repository switched it off, so a repository keeps ticketing its merged specs as before the switch existed; it is flipped at `PUT /api/repos/{owner}/{repo}/loops/tickets`.

- **`specs/spec-tickets/spec.md` FR15**: Selecting the Spec tickets loop (or viewing All loops) shows one row per spec named by its directory (`widgets`) and titled by its path (`specs/widgets/spec.md`) in **Current**, **Parked** (with the failure reason), or **Recently addressed** (completed in the last 7 days) based on its newest run, with the subject column headed **Spec** when filtered to Spec tickets alone and a paused notice in Backlog when switched off.

Pull request #3357 in re-cinq/lore: Spec upkeep joins the Loops tab: a switch, and its runs and pull requests on the board
State: merged
Author: gedaiu
Opened: 2026-10-23T16:21:28Z
Closed: 2026-10-23T16:53:51Z
Merged: 2026-10-23T16:53:51Z
Link: https://github.com/re-cinq/lore/pull/3357

Spec upkeep becomes the fifth loop on the Loops tab. Its switch is `spec_upkeep.enabled`, on unless a repository switches it off, so every repository keeps the weekly upkeep it has today; the Monday tick now skips a repository whose loop is off (`enabledUpkeepRepos`).

## What Changed

- `LOOP_KINDS` gains `tickets` (**Spec tickets**), seventh in the tab.
Its switch is `lore.repos.settings.spec_tickets.enabled`, on by omission
like triage and upkeep, so no repository changes behaviour at deploy;
`PUT /api/repos/:o/:r/loops/tickets` flips it (`loop-switch.ts`), and
`RepoSettingsSchema` knows the block.
- `startSpecTicketRuns` asks `loopOn(repo)` before reading the pull
request's files; the stations handler answers it from the repository's
settings. A switched-off repository's merged spec starts no run.
- `GET /api/repos/:o/:r/spec-tickets` (`routes/spec-tickets/`): the
shared loop sections from the line's 40 newest runs, one row per spec
named by its directory (read out of the run's subject key,
`specNameOfRunKey`) and titled by its path. Current, a spec …
